main_text.p: قوله ﻣﻜﻦ وبعضه في ﻣﺤﻞ ﻛﺎﻻﻣﺮ والنهي والخبر والاسﻢ [?] خبار partim non in subjecto, ut dictum ejus, كن Esto [scil. in creatione rerum] & partim in subjecto ut mandatum, & Prohibitio, & Narratio, & Interrogatio, &c. Idem etiam Alfobbaiensem, (qui & apud Motazalos lectæ princeps) asseruisse ait, loqui Deum بكلام مخلوق في محل Sermone quem creat in subjecto, scil. (ut explicat Author libri AlMawakef, كاللوح المحفوظ او جبريل او النبي in tabula[in coelis] repofita, in Gabriele, in Propheta, &c. Contra AlMotazalos hac de re disputant qui se pro Orthodoxis haberi volunt verbum Dei nec voce & literis consistere, nec creatum & in subjecto esse contendentes, differentiâ tamen, quæ & Authori libri Mawakef, ejusque expositori videtur, conciliari possit adhibita distinctione verbi in كلاما لفظيا verbum prolatum, & الدعني القا يم بالنفس signficationem seu intentionem in mente subsistentem, seu permanentem: seu in الغنسي mentale, seu mente conceptum, & الافظي Sermone prolatum, seu orale.v. Sharko Ta-wakea & Al-Mawakef, & AlGazal, &c.

P.31. l.1.E Motazalis autem Ahmed Ebn Hayet asseruit Christum corpus proprie dictum induisse, &c.] Hunc cum e secta AlNodamianorum (qui ab Abrahamo AlNodham denominati sunt) fuerat, postea novam sibi, novarum post lectos Philosophorum libros opinionum accessione condidisse, qui ab ipso AlHayetiani dicti sunt, refert AlSharestaniu, atque idem asseruisse ipsum cum Christianis في اعتقادهم ان المسيح هو النبي محاسب nis الخلق

page.notes: Arabic text is hard to read in places: the word after "والاسم" on the second line and several words in the Arabic lines are uncertain and marked [?] or left as read. The Arabic line ending "nis الخلق" has a Latin fragment "nis" inside the Arabic line, copied as printed. The note "v. Sharko Ta-wakea" is also uncertain in its spelling. The printed square bracket after "induisse, &c." is left as printed.
